basic.Visa (Japanese, short stay): Visa-free up to 90 days with ESTA
basic.Main exports: Petroleum products, machinery, aircraft, semiconductors, farm goods

United States of America.levelNote: No advisory (spot notices on gun crime and demonstrations)
United States of America.jp: Japan's only treaty ally; about 50,000 US troops are stationed in Japan. One of Japan's biggest export markets (cars, machinery). Tariffs and defence cost-sharing are perennial issues.
United States of America.volt: 120V / Type A (same shape as Japan; many devices need no converter)
trivia: The national anthem's melody comes from an English drinking song, 'To Anacreon in Heaven'.
Laws differ sharply by state: the death penalty, cannabis legality and sales-tax rates all vary.
Alaska was bought from Russia in 1867 for $7.2 million and mocked as 'Seward's Folly'.
The Pentagon has about 28 km of corridors, yet any two points are said to be within a 7-minute walk.

legend.b: The classic rumour that a crashed UFO and aliens are kept at the Nevada air base. It was in fact a test site for the U-2 and stealth aircraft; the CIA acknowledged its existence in 2013.
A supposed secret-government bunker beneath the airport, fuelled by eerie murals and the giant blue horse statue nicknamed 'Blucifer'.
An alleged 13,000-year-old artificial satellite orbiting Earth. The photo shows a thermal blanket dropped from the ISS.

news.ja: 中間選挙、開票進行中
news.h: Midterm elections: counting under way
news.b: The vote is seen as a report card on Trump's second term. All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats are up. A final NYT poll had Democrats ahead in all seven swing states; they need +4 in the Senate and +3 in the House for majorities.

news.ja: イラン攻撃再開を示唆
news.h: Trump hints at renewed strikes on Iran
news.b: On Oct 31 Trump said 'one or two targets' still need dealing with. Reports say Netanyahu has urged a post-election strike.

news.ja: ロシア・ウクライナ3者協議を仲介
news.h: US to broker Russia–Ukraine talks
news.b: Envoy Witkoff and Jared Kushner will attend the Abu Dhabi talks on Nov 10–11.

news.ja: メラニア夫人が5日にロシア・ウクライナ代表をホワイトハウスに招待
news.h: Melania Trump to host Russian and Ukrainian envoys on Nov 5
news.b: Announced by the White House as a prelude to the Nov 10–11 Abu Dhabi talks.

news.ja: トランプ氏支持率32%、過去最低付近
news.h: Trump approval at 32%, near record low
news.b: Reuters/Ipsos poll. Generic ballot: Democrats 46%, Republicans 38%. Some Republicans privately blame Trump for likely losses.

news.ja: イラン・ケシュム島へ限定的攻撃と米当局者
news.h: US officials report limited strike on Iran's Qeshm Island
news.b: Trump said oil prices have fallen sharply and that 'Iran wants a deal'.

basic.Main exports: Crude oil, natural gas, coal, wheat, metals

Russia.levelNote: Level 3 nationwide (avoid all travel); Level 4 in regions bordering Ukraine
Russia.jp: The Northern Territories dispute means no peace treaty has ever been signed. Relations cooled sharply after the invasion of Ukraine; the Sakhalin LNG stakes remain a sensitive issue.
trivia: The Trans-Siberian Railway runs ≈9,300 km from Moscow to Vladivostok — about 7 days end to end.
Lake Baikal is the deepest lake (≈1,642 m) and holds about a fifth of the world's fresh water.
Roughly 65% of the territory is permafrost.
The Cold War 'Dead Hand' (Perimeter) system really existed: automated nuclear retaliation even if leadership was wiped out.

legend.b: In 1959 nine hikers died mysteriously in the Urals, having cut their way out of their tent from inside. UFO and secret-weapon theories abound; a 2021 study supports a slab avalanche.
A supposed second, government-only metro network beneath Moscow's. Russian authorities neither confirm nor deny it.
A shortwave station that has broadcast a buzzing tone for decades, occasionally reading out codes by voice. Often linked to the 'Dead Hand'.

news.ja: ザポリージャ州の学校を空爆、26人以上死亡
news.h: Air strike on school in Zaporizhzhia kills at least 26
news.b: Multiple aerial bombs hit a school being used as an aid distribution point, hours after a local ceasefire in Kherson ended.

news.ja: アブダビでの3者協議を確認
news.h: Kremlin confirms Abu Dhabi trilateral talks
news.b: Presidential aide Medinsky will lead the delegation on Nov 10–11.

news.ja: 燃料不足が深刻化
news.h: Fuel shortages deepen
news.b: Ukrainian drone strikes have damaged energy facilities, with scuffles reported at petrol stations. A teenager was detained in Moscow over a terror plot.

news.ja: ルーマニア領空へドローン侵入
news.h: Drones enter Romanian airspace
news.b: Romania scrambled F-16s to shoot them down and expelled a Russian diplomat.

Ukraine.jp: Japan is one of the main donors for budget and reconstruction support and hosted a recovery conference in Tokyo in 2024. Over 2,000 evacuees have been accepted.
top: Largest country wholly in Europe (excluding Russia)
Built the world's largest aircraft, the An-225 (destroyed in 2022)
trivia: One of the world's great black-earth belts — 'the breadbasket of Europe'.
Kyiv's Arsenalna metro station is about 105 m deep, one of the world's deepest.
Under the 1994 Budapest Memorandum it gave up the world's third-largest nuclear arsenal.

legend.b: Staff supposedly saw a giant black bird-like creature just before the 1986 disaster — likely a spin-off of America's Mothman legend.
Former quarries said to run over 2,500 km with no complete map; rumour has it that those who enter never return.
A wartime ghost story of a vanished unit still marching at night, with variants across the country.

news.ja: ザポリージャ州で26人以上死亡
news.h: At least 26 killed in Zaporizhzhia region
news.b: An air strike hit a school distributing aid. Zelensky said hopes for peace had been 'shattered'.

news.ja: ヘルソン州の局地停戦が終了
news.h: Local ceasefire in Kherson region ends
news.b: The humanitarian pause, brokered by Melania Trump, ran from Oct 27 to Nov 1 with no violations reported by either side.

news.ja: 米・露・ウ3者協議をアブダビで開催
news.h: US–Russia–Ukraine talks set for Abu Dhabi
news.b: Agenda: post-war security, de-escalation and humanitarian issues — a push for a breakthrough before winter.

news.ja: オレシュキ住民への支援物資搬入で月1回以上の仕組みにロシアと合意
news.h: Deal with Russia on monthly aid deliveries to Oleshky
news.b: Zelensky also wants to discuss Starlink throttling with Elon Musk, who has not responded.

Iran.jp: Japan imports most of its oil from the Middle East and is among the countries most exposed to a Hormuz closure. Tokyo has traditionally kept a dialogue-based line with Tehran.
trivia: The ancient Persian Royal Road had a relay post system that covered ≈2,700 km in seven days.
Persian carpets deliberately include a flaw: only God is perfect.
Home of the Cyrus Cylinder (6th c. BC), often called the first human-rights charter.
The Iranian solar calendar starts at the spring equinox; 2026 spans 1404–1405.

legend.b: Ruined desert towns are said to be inhabited by jinn who spirit away anyone approaching at night.
Visitors who pocket stones from the ruins supposedly suffer misfortune; returned stones reinforce the tale.
Since the 1990s fishermen have repeatedly reported a 'fish with a human face'.

news.ja: 「要求が通れば2日以内にホルムズ海峡開放」
news.h: 'Hormuz can reopen within two days if demands are met'
news.b: The strait has been effectively closed since the US–Iran war began in late February. Via Qatari mediation, Tehran says it will reopen if its 'seven-step' terms — lifting the US naval blockade and sanctions, reducing US forces — are accepted.

news.ja: ホルムズ海峡でタンカー炎上
news.h: Tanker ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz
news.b: Instability continues; in normal times about a fifth of the world's oil and LNG passes through.

news.ja: 米・イスラエルが攻撃再開を示唆
news.h: US and Israel signal renewed strikes
news.b: Trump mentioned 'one or two targets' including Mount Kolang (Pickaxe). Iran warned it would respond 'without geographic limits'.

news.ja: 1月の抗議デモ関連で2人を処刑
news.h: Two executed over January protests
news.b: Convicted of killing police officers. The hard line continues under new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

news.ja: 最高指導者が和平交渉を承認、米との間接協議『極めて集中的』
news.h: Supreme Leader approves peace talks; indirect US contacts 'very intense'
news.b: President Pezeshkian says he has been given authority to negotiate. Oil fell ≈6%, gold rose. A 'Martyrs for Iran' brigade was formed after 24 million reportedly volunteered.

basic.Capital: Jerusalem (not internationally recognised; most embassies in Tel Aviv)

Israel.levelNote: Mostly Level 2; Level 4 around Gaza and the Lebanon border; Level 3 in the West Bank (revised Sept 2026)
Israel.jp: Relations are good, with growing cooperation in start-ups and semiconductors. On Palestine, Japan supports a two-state solution.
Israel.volt: 230V / Types C & H (H is unique to Israel)
trivia: Hebrew is the only language to be revived from a 'dead' tongue to everyday use, in the late 19th century.
The Dead Sea shore, ≈430 m below sea level, is the lowest land point on Earth.
About 60% of the land is desert (Negev); drip irrigation was invented here.
Tel Aviv never sleeps; Jerusalem shuts down on the Sabbath.

legend.b: Originally from Prague, but told here as a guardian made of clay — now a metaphor in AI and robotics.
Travellers suddenly believing they are prophets after visiting the holy city; documented in psychiatric case reports.
The Ark of the Covenant is said to lie beneath the Temple Mount; excavation is religiously and politically impossible.

news.ja: ネタニヤフ首相、米選挙後のイラン攻撃を要求か
news.h: Netanyahu reportedly urges post-election strike on Iran
news.b: Media reports only; warnings of renewed strikes are growing in step with Washington.

news.ja: 国際部隊のガザ入りを承認
news.h: International force approved for Gaza
news.b: For security duties; timing undecided. A year after the ceasefire, attacks and displacement continue.

news.ja: 総選挙後の連立交渉が難航
news.h: Coalition talks stall after election
news.b: Arab parties do not meet Eisenkot's coalition conditions; a change of government hangs in the balance.

news.ja: 米が年末で40億ドルの援助停止と表明
news.h: US to halt $4bn in aid at year-end
news.b: Announced by Trump — a notable shift in the relationship.

news.ja: ネタニヤフ首相『テロに反対する全政党と広範な連立を』
news.h: Netanyahu seeks 'broad coalition with any party opposing terror'
news.b: Reports also say two senior Mossad officials were dismissed over an Iran regime-change plan. An air strike near Khan Younis caused casualties among Gaza police.

basic.Main exports: Electrical equipment, machinery, EVs, solar panels, steel

China.levelNote: Level 1 in Xinjiang and Tibet; no advisory elsewhere (note on anti-espionage law)
China.jp: Japan's largest trading partner. Security tensions over the Senkakus and Taiwan coexist with deep economic interdependence; about 100,000 Japanese live in China.
trivia: The country spans ≈5,000 km east to west but keeps a single time zone (Beijing time).
The Great Wall is said to be 'visible from space' — it isn't, to the naked eye.
High-speed rail totals ≈45,000 km, over two-thirds of the world's.
NASA estimated the Three Gorges reservoir slowed Earth's rotation by 0.06 microseconds a day.

legend.b: A Cold War network of air-raid tunnels tens of kilometres long; entrances are said to remain under ordinary houses.
Misfortune is said to follow those who dig at the First Emperor's tomb, which supposedly contains rivers of mercury and remains unopened.
Figures are said to appear at night in wartime air-raid shelters — now a tourist draw.

news.ja: 台湾周辺の海底ケーブルを探査か
news.h: Suspected survey of undersea cables near Taiwan
news.b: Seen as pressure on communications infrastructure.

news.ja: 軍幹部の『空洞化』
news.h: 'Hollowing out' of the military top brass
news.b: Anti-corruption purges have reportedly left senior posts vacant.

news.ja: エムバペ選手発言に強く反発
news.h: Backlash over Mbappé remark
news.b: Mbappé and Hello Kitty's owner apologised; the TBS drama 'VIVANT' also caused a stir.

news.ja: 中国景気減速でアップルが見通し下方修正
news.h: Apple cuts outlook on China slowdown
news.b: Weaker iPhone demand ripples through supply chains.

news.ja: 『イランへの軍事行動に反対』と外務省
news.h: Foreign ministry opposes military action against Iran
news.b: Beijing urged dialogue amid fears of post-midterm strikes, and held the APEC ministerial online.

basic.Main exports: Coal, minerals, textiles (mostly illicit under sanctions)

North Korea.levelNote: Travel discouraged nationwide; the Japanese government asks citizens to refrain from all travel
North Korea.jp: The abduction issue is the biggest sticking point; there are no diplomatic relations. Missile launches often land in or near Japan's EEZ and trigger J-Alert.
top: One of the widest, longest demilitarised zones
trivia: The 105-storey Ryugyong Hotel, begun in 1987, was long the world's tallest empty building.
It uses its own Juche calendar, with 1912 (Kim Il Sung's birth) as year 1.
The DMZ has become a haven for endangered species because no one may enter.
TV sets are fixed to state channels only.

legend.b: Kijong-dong by the DMZ is said in the South to be an empty showcase village.
Official lore says Kim Jong Il was born on Mt Paektu under a double rainbow and a new star; he was in fact born in the Soviet Union.
Broadcasts reading out digits are said to be coded messages to agents; the South monitors them as 'random-number broadcasts'.

news.ja: 香港の密輸組織が武器を『冷蔵庫』と偽装
news.h: Hong Kong smugglers disguised weapons as 'refrigerators'
news.b: Arms were reportedly hidden in a North Korean diplomat's household shipment.

news.ja: ベラルーシと友好条約
news.h: Friendship treaty with Belarus
news.b: Includes mutual support on security policy — tightening ties within Russia's orbit.

news.ja: 暗号資産の大規模窃取
news.h: Large-scale crypto theft
news.b: The Binance hack has put the spotlight on a multibillion-dollar theft operation.

Japan.jp: This is Japan itself; see each country's entry for how it relates to Japan.
Japan.volt: 100V / Type A (lowest mains voltage in the world)
trivia: Kongo Gumi, founded in 578, is the world's oldest company (temple construction, Osaka).
About 4 million vending machines — the most per capita anywhere.
Between 1,000 and 2,000 perceptible earthquakes a year.
The lyrics of 'Kimigayo' are among the oldest of any anthem (a 10th-century poem).

legend.b: A 2004 message-board account of someone alighting at a station that does not exist — one of the roots of Japanese internet horror.
The 'slit-mouthed woman' panic of 1979 ('Am I pretty?') led to group walks home and school closures.
A vast fortune supposedly hidden by the shogunate at the end of the Edo period; repeatedly dug for on Mt Akagi, never found.

news.ja: スペイン列車事故で邦人1人の死亡を確認
news.h: Japanese national confirmed dead in Spain train crash
news.b: Announced by local authorities.

news.ja: 日米豪印（QUAD）外相会談
news.h: Quad foreign ministers meet
news.b: Cooperation on AI and other areas confirmed.

news.ja: フーシ派幹部「日本船は狙わず」
news.h: Houthi official: 'We will not target Japanese ships'
news.b: He also denied collecting transit fees off Yemen.

news.ja: ノジマで700万人分の個人情報流出
news.h: Nojima leaks data on 7 million customers
news.b: A major domestic incident.

news.ja: 防衛費を5年で70〜80兆円へ倍増検討
news.h: Japan weighs doubling defence spending to ¥70–80 trillion over five years
news.b: Nearly double the current plan, with much of the increase going to drones. Defence Minister Koizumi also raised revisiting the three non-nuclear principles and acquiring nuclear-powered submarines.

news.ja: 米海兵隊員が外出禁止時間中に飲酒運転で2人目の逮捕
news.h: Second US Marine arrested for drink-driving during curfew
news.b: The defence minister demanded stricter discipline from US forces.

Romania.levelNote: No advisory (notice on drone debris near the Ukrainian border)
Romania.jp: Diplomatic ties date from 1902. Romania is a rear base for Japanese relief shipments to Ukraine.
top: Danube Delta is Europe's largest wetland
trivia: Romanian is the only Romance language surrounded by Slavic ones.
Bucharest's Palace of the Parliament is the second-largest administrative building after the Pentagon.
The Transfăgărășan is often called the world's most beautiful road.

legend.b: Bran Castle is marketed as Dracula's home, though Vlad III barely stayed there.
'The most haunted forest in the world': vanished shepherds, UFO photos and spinning compasses.
A supposed ancient holographic facility under the Sphinx rock, allegedly sealed with US help.

news.ja: ロシア軍ドローンを連続迎撃
news.h: Romania shoots down Russian drones on consecutive days
news.b: F-16s responded to three straight days of airspace violations — the first shoot-downs inside Romanian airspace.

news.ja: ロシア外交官に退去通告、駐モスクワ大使を召還
news.h: Russian diplomat expelled, ambassador recalled from Moscow
news.b: Moscow said it 'would not stay silent'.

news.ja: NATO最東端の緊張
news.h: Tension on NATO's eastern edge
news.b: A 650 km border with Ukraine means direct exposure to Black Sea fighting.

Saudi Arabia.levelNote: Level 3 in Riyadh, Eastern, Makkah and Madinah provinces (raised Oct 2026); Level 2 in northern provinces
Saudi Arabia.jp: Japan's largest crude supplier, about 40% of imports. Close ties between the imperial and royal families.
top: The Hajj (2 million+) is the world's largest religious gathering
trivia: Mostly desert, with no permanent rivers.
The Rub' al Khali ('Empty Quarter') is larger than France.
Shop closures for the five daily prayers have been relaxed in recent years.
Over 2 million pilgrims gather for the Hajj each year.

legend.b: A 170 km, 500 m-tall mirrored city. Reported downsizing has led to jokes about 'the city that doesn't exist'.

legend.h: The lost city in the Empty Quarter
legend.b: Legendary Ubar, swallowed by sand; a 1992 satellite survey found ruins, half-confirming the tale.
Lights are said to flicker at night in unfinished skyscrapers.

news.ja: 米国と共同でイラク空爆
news.h: Joint air strikes with the US on Iraq
news.b: Iraq's presidency called it a 'violation of sovereignty'; pro-Iran militias vowed retaliation.

news.ja: フーシ派がサウジのタンカーを攻撃
news.h: Houthis attack Saudi tanker
news.b: Claimed as a response to a 'violation of the Red Sea blockade'; shipping risk rises.

basic.Member of: EU, NATO (highest defence spending share in NATO)

Poland.levelNote: No advisory (notice for areas near the Ukrainian border)
Poland.jp: Strong cultural ties through Chopin and Japanese anime. Served as a hub for SDF transport flights during the Ukraine refugee response.
top: Highest defence spending as % of GDP in NATO
trivia: Warsaw's Old Town was rebuilt from paintings after the war and is a World Heritage site.
Copernicus, Marie Curie and Chopin were all Polish.
The Wieliczka salt mine has an underground chapel carved from salt.
Name days are celebrated like birthdays.

legend.b: The city's emblem: a mermaid who vowed to protect the town after a fisherman saved her.
Said to have lived under Kraków's castle; a fire-breathing statue stands by the cave.
Some 400 pines near Gryfino bend 90° at the base — cause still unknown.

news.ja: ワルシャワ行き2便に爆破予告
news.h: Bomb threats against two Warsaw-bound flights
news.b: A LOT flight diverted to Modlin, which briefly closed; an SAS flight was also threatened. At least seven flights were hit across Europe; no explosives found.

news.ja: 犯行声明なし
news.h: No claim of responsibility
news.b: Threats also hit Bulgaria, Italy and Spain the same day; authorities suspect coordinated disruption.

United Kingdom.jp: A traditional partner since the 1902 alliance. Co-developing the GCAP next-generation fighter with Italy.
top: 2nd only to the US in top-ranked universities
trivia: It has no single written constitution.
Ravens are kept at the Tower of London because legend says the kingdom falls if they leave.
The world's shortest scheduled flight (Westray–Papa Westray) takes about a minute.
Big Ben is the bell, not the tower.

legend.b: An Egyptian princess is said to haunt the closed British Museum station.
A leaping, fire-breathing figure sighted across 19th-century London — a classic urban legend.
The Loch Ness Monster. The 1934 'surgeon's photo' was a hoax, yet sightings continue.

news.ja: 首相が奴隷貿易の正式謝罪を検討
news.h: PM considers formal apology for slave trade
news.b: A major issue for Commonwealth relations.

news.ja: 元アンドルー王子のエプスタイン関連訪問を警察が捜査
news.h: Police investigate ex-Prince Andrew's Epstein-linked visit
news.b: Scottish police are looking into a trip to a royal estate.

news.ja: ロンドン発便が爆破予告の標的に
news.h: London departures targeted by bomb threats
news.b: Including Heathrow–Warsaw and Manchester–Murcia flights.

news.ja: 永住権取得に必要な居住期間を5年→10年に
news.h: Settlement wait doubled from 5 to 10 years
news.b: The Home Secretary said it applies to some 500,000 already waiting. The EU's top diplomat called any UK return to the EU 'very difficult'.

news.ja: 中国人留学生が失踪、特殊詐欺の可能性
news.h: Chinese student missing, scam suspected
news.b: A Tsinghua/UCL student; the Chinese embassy is following up.

South Korea.jp: Japan's nearest neighbour. History disputes persist, but security cooperation and travel (10 million+ visits a year) are at record highs.
trivia: Hangul was created in 1443 by King Sejong; its promulgation day is a holiday.
Internet speeds have long ranked among the world's fastest.
About half the population lives in greater Seoul.
Men serve roughly 18 months of military service.

legend.b: The belief that sleeping with an electric fan on in a closed room can kill; makers long fitted timers in response.
Korea's version of Kuchisake-onna: a woman in a red mask asks 'Am I pretty?'.
A hitch-hiking ghost on the Freedom Road near Paju, close to the DMZ.

news.ja: 10月の輸出額が前年比ほぼ倍増
news.h: October exports nearly double year on year
news.b: Driven by chips; Hanwha won a US Navy landing-ship order.

news.ja: 出生率が反転、各国のモデルに
news.h: Birth rate rebounds, drawing global attention
news.b: Cash support and childcare expansion are credited with reversing the world's lowest rate.

news.ja: 李在明大統領らのパスポート情報がネット流出
news.h: Passport data of President Lee and officials leaked online
news.b: An investigation and passport reissues follow.

basic.Note: Including overseas territories, one of the largest EEZs

France.levelNote: No advisory (notices on terrorism and pickpockets)
France.jp: Ties date from the 1858 treaty. Japanese food and anime are hugely popular; Japan Expo is Europe's largest Japanese-culture event.
trivia: France spans 12 time zones thanks to its overseas territories.
Paris's arrondissements spiral outward from 1 to 20.
The baguette is defined by law and was listed as intangible heritage in 2022.
The Eiffel Tower grows about 15 cm in summer heat.

legend.b: Six million skeletons lie under Paris; explorers who stray off the map are said never to return.
In 1901 two Englishwomen claimed to have seen 18th-century figures at the Petit Trianon — the Moberly–Jourdain incident.
An unidentified animal that attacked over 100 people in the 18th century: wolf, hyena or human?

news.ja: 安保理で仏大使の発言中に米代表団が退席
news.h: US delegation walks out during French envoy's UN speech
news.b: A protest over remarks on the human-rights chief's reappointment that lumped the US with authoritarian states.

news.ja: 2027年大統領選に向けた前哨戦
news.h: Run-up to the 2027 presidential race
news.b: Le Pen is reported ahead; Germany's chancellor said he would work with her if she won.

news.ja: 仏中銀総裁『市場は財政状況に過剰反応』
news.h: Bank of France chief: markets 'overreacting' to fiscal worries
news.b: He expects the budget to pass. France and Germany proposed an EU 'emergency cut-off switch' on imports, seen as aimed at China.

Germany.jp: A model for Meiji-era law and medicine. Rival and partner in cars and machine tools.
trivia: About 70% of the Autobahn has no speed limit.
The 1516 Beer Purity Law is one of the oldest food regulations.
Over 3,000 kinds of bread; German bread culture is intangible heritage.
Shops are closed on Sundays by law.

legend.b: The 1284 record of 130 children vanishing is real; theories range from eastward colonisation to plague.
A giant shadow seen in the Harz mountains — the observer's own shadow in mist, long tied to witches' sabbaths.
Wartime bunkers remain sealed, with undiscovered sections rumoured.

news.ja: 仏大統領選への姿勢を表明
news.h: Chancellor sets stance on French election
news.b: He said Berlin would cooperate even if Le Pen wins, prioritising Franco-German ties.

news.ja: エネルギーと景気の不安
news.h: Energy and growth worries
news.b: Hormuz-driven energy prices and China's slowdown weigh on manufacturing.

news.ja: 仏と共にEU『緊急遮断スイッチ』を提案
news.h: Joins France in proposing EU 'emergency cut-off switch'
news.b: A tool to halt imports in emergencies, seen as aimed at Chinese goods.

Italy.jp: GCAP fighter partner. Mutual love of each other's food; tens of thousands of Italian restaurants in Japan.
trivia: Two independent states lie inside Italy: the Vatican and San Marino.
Pizza became a national dish after the 1889 'Margherita'.
The Colosseum used ancient lifts to raise animals to the arena.
Venice sinks 1–2 mm a year.

legend.b: Tourists who take stones return them with apology letters after runs of bad luck.
Said to hold the world's secrets; renamed the Apostolic Archive in 2019 and largely open to scholars.
Turin is said to be a vertex of a 'white magic' triangle with Lyon and Prague.

news.ja: 生活費高騰で数千人が抗議、一部で衝突
news.h: Thousands protest cost of living; clashes reported
news.b: Demonstrations over prices erupted in several cities.

news.ja: ローマ行き2便に爆破予告、伊空軍が護衛
news.h: Bomb threats on two Rome flights; air force escorts one
news.b: Two Ryanair flights were searched at Fiumicino; nothing found.

Spain.jp: The 1613 Keichō embassy reached near Seville; descendants with the surname 'Japón' still live in Coria del Río.
top: Largest high-speed rail network in Europe
trivia: Geographically in the GMT zone, but kept on Central European Time since the Franco era.
The Sagrada Família, begun in 1882, has long targeted completion around 2026.
Largest olive-oil producer in the world.
Lunch at 2 pm, dinner after 9 pm.

legend.b: Human faces repeatedly appeared on a kitchen floor in Andalusia from 1971; still unexplained.
An abandoned Basque village whose residents supposedly vanished; linked to UFO lore.
